decisions.subject: Approve scanner tools, versions, thresholds, entropy policy, and allowlist.
Review redacted secret and private-data detector findings and authorize any remediation.
Review PII, provider account, tenant, URL, fixture, and topology findings.
Approve binary, large-object, cache, generated-output, and provider-state dispositions.
Approve LICENSE, NOTICE, dependency/source-copy provenance, provider terms, trademarks, assets, fixtures, fonts, and datasets.
Approve contributor identities, email publication, terms, and sign-off policy.
Approve git-filter-repo executable/version digest and the exact technical filter receipt for materialization.
Approve remote visibility, signing, rulesets, CODEOWNERS, target authority, and final materialization route.
Implement and approve real generated-drift, security, and license CI gates before standalone CI or public readiness certification.

prohibitedConclusions: Do not certify public-history, public-release, standalone-CI, remote-authority, or production readiness.
Do not invent dependency versions, copy sibling source, add file/link/workspace fallbacks, or weaken the exact blockers.
Do not materialize a final repository without separate reviewer approval and resolved blockers or an explicitly approved fail-closed materialization contract.
